vb_textbox.text: When the game starts make sure to position your fingers other the required buttons. What I found is that you get more mushrooms when you pick similar gnomes. For example, if you get a gnome with a long hat, select the next gnome that has a long hat. This is the same for the colours and for the shorter gnomes as well. Once you start getting less mushrooms, such as zero, switch to the other type of gnome. For example, if the longer hat gnomes stop giving a lot of mushrooms, switch to the shorter hat mushrooms and go in that pattern.
